title: A scalar multiple of a boundary is supported in the support: S = c·∂T ⇒ spt S ⊆ spt T
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P (U : Set (Euclid P)), T ∈ 𝒟_{n+1}(U) and S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U (n+1), GeometricCurrentOn U n) and c ∈ ℝ. If S(ω) = c·∂T(ω) for every test n-form ω in U (∂T = T.boundary, ∂T(ω) = T(dω)), then spt S ⊆ spt T (GeometricCurrentOn.support, Simon 6.2.11).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (n + 1)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (c : ℝ), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, S ω = c * T.boundary ω) → S.support ⊆ T.support
